installBody: Add Jogoo to your home screen. It opens like an app and works offline.
installIosBody: In Safari, tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.
installAndroidBody: Open your browser menu (⋮), then tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
updateAvailable: A new version of Jogoo is ready.
notFoundBody: This page does not exist in the app.
authTagline: Irrigation, equipment and advice for your farm, in one app.
signUpConsent: By creating an account you agree that JOGOO contacts you about your farm project.
passwordChangedBody: Other devices have been signed out.
offlineAccount: You're offline. Showing your saved account.
errOffline: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errEmailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errWeakPassword: Use at least 8 characters for your password.
errPasswordTooLong: Use at most 72 characters for your password.
errTooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a while (up to an hour) and try again.
errServer: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
statusSubtitle: Follow your JOGOO project step by step
statusQuestionsBody: Your JOGOO advisor is one call away.
stageDesc_signed_up: You created your JOGOO account. An advisor will call you soon.
stageDesc_site_visit: Our team visited your farm to look at your plots and water source.
stageDesc_quote_sent: Your quote is ready. Check your email or WhatsApp.
stageDesc_payment_made: We received your payment. Thank you!
stageDesc_installed: Your system is installed. Welcome to the JOGOO family!
codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It's valid for 10 minutes.
codeSentReset: If {email} has a JOGOO account, we sent it a 6-digit code. It's valid for 10 minutes.
codeCheckSpam: Can't find it? Check your spam folder.
rememberDevice: Trust this device for 30 days (no code needed here)
resetIntro: Enter your account email. We'll send you a 6-digit code to choose a new password.
twoStepNote: For your security, we'll email you a code to confirm it's you.
errInvalidCode: That code isn't right. Check the latest email and try again.
errCodeExpired: This code has expired or was used too many times. Send a new one.
errEmailFailed: We couldn't send the email. Try again in a moment.
errWaitResend: Wait a minute before asking for a new code.
attemptsLeft: {count, plural, =1{1 try left} other{{count} tries left}}
createFarmBody: Tell us about your farm: where it is, what you grow, your water and your equipment. JOGOO uses it to advise you and plan visits.
createFarmSubtitle: You can change any of this later.
farmAreaInvalid: Enter the size in hectares, e.g. 2.5.
cropsHelp: Pick all that apply, or add your own.
extraDetailsHelp: Anything else worth knowing, e.g. soil type, number of plots, workers, electricity.
farmNotesHint: Access road, best time to visit, anything else…
farmAddMoreDetails: Add your location, size and crops so JOGOO can advise you.
farmLoadFailed: We couldn't load your farm. Check your connection.
equipmentCount: {count, plural, =0{No equipment yet} =1{1 piece of equipment} other{{count} pieces of equipment}}
noEquipmentYet: Add the pumps, kits and tanks on your farm to track them and get the right parts.
equipmentNotesHint: Brand, model, where it is on the farm…
removeEquipmentConfirm: Remove {name} from your farm? This can't be undone.
errTooManyEquipment: You've reached the limit of 100 pieces of equipment.
noOrdersYet: No orders yet. Orders you place with JOGOO will appear here.
agronomistEmpty: Ask the JOGOO agronomists anything about your crops and watering.
miaWelcome: Hello {name}, I'm Mia. Ask me about your crops, irrigation or JOGOO equipment.
upsellBody: Get a quote from JOGOO for your project
noNotifications: You're all caught up. Updates on your orders, visits and requests will appear here.
noRequestsYet: No requests yet. Report a problem or book a visit and you can follow it here.
partsSubtitle: Spare parts from the JOGOO range
catalogueNote: Prices depend on quantities and your project: tap Get a quote and JOGOO sales will call you back.
catalogueSoon: These products are in the JOGOO range; their catalogue pages are coming to the app soon.
quoteHelp: Tell us the quantity and your project; JOGOO sales confirm price and delivery by phone.
miaUnavailable: Mia can't be reached right now. Check your connection, or talk to a JOGOO adviser by phone or WhatsApp.
visitsEmpty: When JOGOO plans a visit to your farm, you can follow it here: your technician, his trip and the details.
itineraryTbc: The itinerary will appear here once it is planned.
visitCancelledBody: This visit was cancelled. JOGOO will contact you to plan a new date.
errSessionExpired: You were signed out. Sign in again to continue.
errForbidden: Your account can't do this. Contact JOGOO if you think it should.
errFarmSize: Farm size must be a number of hectares, for example 2.5.
errRequiredFields: Fill in your full name, email and password.
accountDeletedNotice: Your account and its data were deleted.
signOutConfirmBody: You'll need your password and an email code to sign in again.
signOutOfflineWarn: You're offline: you won't be able to sign in again until you have a connection.
deleteAccountBody: This permanently deletes your JOGOO account, your profile and your project status. It can't be undone. Enter your password to confirm.
makeStaffConfirm: Give {name} JOGOO staff access? They will see every client's name, email, phone and farm.
stageConfirm: Move {name} to “{stage}”? The client will see this on their Status tab.
refreshFailed: Couldn't refresh. Showing what was loaded at {time}.
farmSaveLocalOnly: Saved on this screen, but not on your account (no connection). Try again later.
